text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Libya mounts diplomatic offensive among Maghreb Arab Union partners, with visits to Tunisia, Algeria and Morocco, against European rapid intervention force.
-- World food summit saw efforts without great conviction.
-- Moroccan and Egyptian ministers examine setting up free trade zone between their countries.
-- Head of parliamentary foreign affair commission terms meetings with German officials positive and fruitful.
-- Police prevent holding of meeting to constitute Reform and Unity Party in northern town of Tetouan.
-- Morocco at crossroads as it celebrates independence anniversary. Global reforms must be applied to achieve development and social justice.
